description: Lietuvoje įregistruotų kelių transporto priemonių duomenys is a dataset listed in data.gov.lt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Akcinė bendrovė „REGITRA“. The date of data collection of road vehicles registered in the Road Vehicle Register of the Republic of Lithuania. Coverage: Akcinė bendrovė „REGITRA“. The portal shows the English title as "Data on road vehicles registered in Lithuania" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Akcinė bendrovė „REGITRA“. Its keywords include Demo, Transporto Parkas, Automobilis, Kelių Transporto, Transporto Priemonė. The listing shows 2025-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.lt). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lt.
